newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 23. [CORRECTED 01:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Oct 23. [CORRECTED 01:40 GMT]

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow Jones slid by 29.07 points to 6,061.80. PLDT's ADR fell by $0.25 to $59 7/8.
* The peso closed at 26.276 to a U.S.dollar from 26.273.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,073.12, down 19.22. (Corrects closing figures)
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate dropped to 11.3125 percent from 11.34375.
* Philippine Stock Exchange holds key meeting to vote on crucial reforms.
* Securities and Exchange Commission cracks down on backdoor listings.
* Coupon rate of the Philippines' seven-year Treasury bond falls to 14.875 percent from 15.75 percent, the Bureau of Treasury said.
* The nine-month fiscal surplus went down to 7.49 billion pesos as against 8.6 billion pesos posted in the same period last year.
* Dharmala Securities maintains that the market will continue to consolidate with the index testing the 3,020 level today.
